findings.label: Answer extraction order not guaranteed
findings.description: Object.values(response.answers) iterates by insertion order of JS object keys, but the Google Forms API keys answers by item ID (GUID), not by position. The textAnswers filter may return fields in a different order, silently producing wrong names and matricules.
findings.action: Store the item IDs for Nom and Matricule (from forms.forms.get already called in exportQuiz, via items[].questionItem.question.questionId) as googleNomItemId and googleMatriculeItemId on the Quiz entity, then index directly into response.answers[nomItemId] in syncNotes.

findings.label: mapGoogleError double-throw pattern
findings.description: Both catch blocks call this.mapGoogleError(err) then follow with throw err. For unknown errors mapGoogleError re-throws and the outer throw never runs; for known statuses the outer throw is dead code. The pattern creates a confusing read path.
findings.action: Remove the trailing 'throw err' lines from both catch sites — TypeScript accepts mapGoogleError's 'never' return type as exhaustion proof.

findings.label: prenom field repurposed to carry matricule
findings.description: syncNotes stores the student matricule in QuizResultat.prenom. This field is shared with the share-link submission path (soumettre) which writes a genuine first name. Any code iterating quiz.resultats across both paths mixes semantics silently.
findings.action: Add matricule?: string to QuizResultat and populate it in syncNotes. Leave prenom empty or use it for its intended purpose.
